title: Host restarts for updates only when idle; short reconnects are silent
body:
2026-10-02: the owner's OpenAgents Terminal showed "OpenAgents cannot be reached. Trying again until it can; Esc stops." mid-message. `oa-terminal-dev` (Super+Return, also run by agents as `--build-only` after pushes) rebuilt the release `coder` and ran `systemctl --user restart com.openagents.desktop.host.service` while the message was in flight; the control connection dropped and the client showed `Event::Offline` for ~1 s. Same mechanism as #10168.

Fix:
1. The host restarts for an update only when idle: `SIGUSR1` asks it to start again once no request is in flight or just answered on any path (control socket, relay, direct channel), no chat reply streams, and no device holds a terminal. It re-execs as the same PID and hands the bound control socket to the new program, so clients connecting meanwhile wait in the socket's queue. A stop (`SIGTERM`) first drains requests being answered (up to 10 s).
2. The chat client says nothing for an outage shorter than 3 s; `Online` only follows an `Offline`. Applies to the terminal and `openagents chat`.
3. Wording: "Reconnecting to OpenAgents… (Esc stops)" / "(Ctrl-C stops)"; rail "reconnecting · Esc stops".
4. coderos-hosts `oa-terminal-dev`: only an interactive launch starts the background host rebuild; `--build-only` never does; the rebuild sends SIGUSR1 instead of a hard restart.
